brought to an end by his constituency is known as

C. recall D. return

candidate.subject: government
candidate.question: The principle whereby a legislator's tenure is abruptly brought to an end by his constituency is known as
candidate.explanation: Recall allows constituents to remove an elected representative before the normal end of the term. It is a mechanism of direct electoral accountability, distinct from an ordinary election at the end of a term.

41. The term, comprador borgeoisie, has been used by
scholars to describe
A. foreign businessmen in Nigeria
B. foreign diplomats working in Nigeria
C. Nigeria businessmen who represent foreign
interests
D. Nigeria contractors to foreign government

candidate.subject: government
candidate.question: The term comprador bourgeoisie has been used by scholars to describe

options.C: Nigerian businessmen who represent foreign interests

candidate.explanation: The term describes a domestic business class acting as agents or partners of foreign economic interests. It refers to local intermediaries, rather than foreign diplomats or simply all foreign business owners.
